acceptance: An upstream omp issue exists with a minimal reproduction, or the docs are confirmed to describe the intended behaviour.
The owner's personal config is rekeyed by primary model id, or the owner accepts default-chain fallback.
context: Possibly related to the OMP candidate canary failure: live-quota-fallback-walk expects the Sonnet quota walk to reach openai-codex/gpt-6.1-sol but streams only reached google-antigravity/claude-sonnet-5-5 (see omp-candidate-quota-fallback-walk-red-20261109). Not established that the cause is OMP ignoring the chain; the stream was not captured.
description:
omp's documentation shows `retry.fallbackChains` keyed by role name. With omp 18.12.1 (linux-x64, the oracle's pinned build), `--model @review`, `@plan` and `@slow` walked the `default` chain after a usage-limit 429, not their own chains; chains keyed by the primary model id were honoured. Found 2026-10-22 against a stub provider (no real provider calls).

BenchBox impact: until PR #3296 merges, the oracle reads the owner's config from `OMP_AGENT_CONFIG`, whose chains are keyed by role, so every reviewer alias falls back along the default chain. #3296 commits reviewer chains keyed by model id, and a test rejects role-name keys. The owner's personal config has the same issue.
